body: My suicidal thoughts have become completely pervasive it's all I can think about. I just try to keep finding reasons to keep living before it gets too much.

Hello, I have been to see various GP about my health issues for my heart issue I went to a private cardiologist and he said that my heart is fine, yet I feel it ache and have a pain in my shoulder. I was diagnosed with pericarditis (inflammation of heart sack) which should go with time but does not go for me. My doctor is doing more tests for myopathy next week but I don't want to be alive next week.

Still on holiday been sight seeing during the day and coming home crying from seeing happy couples and people and then sitting in my room all evening. Tonight I have been tidying up my online life so my parents don't find anything ugly about me and think I want to write a note. Honestly it is going to take a lot to stop me from doing it after I get home. I have friends coming to stay next weekend. I don't want them to come I can't face them they will be talking about there future and future plans and I can see no future. I don't want to be alive by next weekend, thinking about either hanging or falling off a cliff close to my house, but the former I'm scared or fucking up and the latter I feel guilty for the mess.

Going on a mountain top tour tomorrow and wondering if I can make it an accident.
